full_page.content:
1947, January 10th
Page 2 (a P.S. to the previous page.)
Mr. and Mrs. Joseph and Winifred O'Donnell
In the mean time do not forget to say little prayer now and then that I make a little faster progress in conversion the coming fifty years than during the past. Ofcourse the next will probably shorter than the past twenty-five.
Praised by Jesus, Mary and Joseph.
Fr. Sol.
